title: Rack-level 60-second graceful event with thermal model
description: V3 整 rack 60s graceful 整合 sim,8 BBU 並聯(symmetric assumption)+ LIC bank 2×Eaton XLR-48-166 並聯 + 一階互補濾波器 τ=0.5s + GPU power-cap 3-stage ramp(peak hold 0.5s / linear ramp 1.5s / continuous 58.0s)+ lumped cell thermal model。Per-BBU peak 6.0C pulse < 2s,continuous 1.50C,皆在車規 LFP datasheet 允許區內。

topology.symmetric_assumption: All 8 BBUs see identical scaled current; one PyBaMM cell represents all 8 in symmetric load-sharing case. N-1 asymmetric case is V4.
